SCRIPT W-Am: Hello, Forest Grove Photography Services. How can I help you? M-Cn: Hi, I'd like to get a photographer to cover our event. It's a charity basketball game next Tuesday night. I was hoping to get Thomas Zukowski. He works for you, right? W-Am: Yes, but unfortunately, Thomas doesn't usually work evenings. M-Cn: Oh, too bad. Could you recommend somebody else? W-Am: Before I do that, let me talk to him. He might make an exception. Tom does love basketball.

SCRIPT W-Cn: Good morning. It looks like we received a lot of new orders online last night. W-Br: Yes, I saw that when I got in this morning. Can you package all of them by yourself? M-Cn: Well, there are so many, I may not be able to finish everything today. W-Br: OK. I’ll call Maria Jeong and ask if she can come in early today to help. M-Cn: That’d be great. We also have to pack that big shipment for the Henderson order. We finally got all of the items in. W-Br: Oh, yes, do that first.

SCRIPT M-Au: Haruna, we've planned most of the details for the corporate retreat, including housing and most activities, but we still need to decide where to go for Saturday's closing dinner. W-Am: Yes, I sent you several menus. Did you like any of the places? McNally's is close by. M-Au: Yes, that would be convenient. We could even walk there from the hotel. But the prices are a little high. W-Am: I agree. But I could see if they can offer us a reduced catering rate, rather than ordering off the regular menu.

SCRIPT W-Am: Janelie and Rico, could you give me an update on how our new medical records software is coming? W-Br: Sure. Per the customer's request, I've updated the logo and changed the font. M-Cn: The customer has communicated with us a lot on this project. Having their feedback at every stage of the process has been helpful. W-Am: Excellent. lt sounds like we're on schedule for completing our beta version. Then we can hand it off to our marketing team.

SCRIPT M-Cn: Hello, this is Ian Nelson from Regal Bathrooms. I'm following up to make sure that you're pleased with the job our workers did in your house. W-Am: Thank you for calling. Yes. They did a great job. The bathroom floor was replaced, and the new tile looks great. I'm very happy with the job. M-Cn: That's good to hear. If there are other jobs you need done, I hope you'll reach out to us again. W-Am: That reminds me. I was thinking of replacing my kitchen cabinets. Is that something you'd possibly do? M-Cn: We don't, but l can recommend a company I often work with. Their customers have been very satisfied. Let me get their phone number. One second. W-Am: Thanks.

SCRIPT W-Br: My name is Laura. I refill my medication here at this pharmacy once a month. But on Monday I'm going to travel abroad for work for two months, and I wonder if I can get a two-month refill this time. M-Cn: It shouldn't be a problem. However, your doctor must send us the two-month prescription, so you need to contact her first. W-Br: Oh, I see. l'll give her a call during my lunch break today. When are you open until today? M-Cn: Until nine p.m. But once we receive your doctor's prescription, we can deliver the medication directly to your home.

SCRIPT M-Au: Miller's Sporting Goods. Joey speaking. W-Am: Hello, I'm calling from West End High School. We're looking to make a big purchase for our student baseball teams. Our equipment is getting old, and we would like to get new uniforms too. We have budget restrictions, though. M-Au: Well, we do offer discounts for bulk purchases. And we have a number of price ranges for uniforms; many are very reasonable. Let me get the manager on the phone, and you can discuss the specifics.

SCRIPT W-Br: Hi, this is Gemini Flowers. I'm calling about the order you placed for your award luncheon on July twelfth. Unfortunately, our supplier is out of pink roses. M-Cn: Oh, no! Pink matches our corporate logo! I ordered them especially for this occasion! W-Br: I understand your disappointment, sir. I can offer a ten percent discount on the total cost of your order and replace the pink roses with yellow ones. M-Cn: Well, l didn't tell anyone about the roses. I suppose no one will really be disappointed.

SCRIPT W-Br: Unfortunately, our development team has some bad news. It turns out we’ll need to push back the shipment of the prototype motor we’ve been developing for our client. M-Cn: Uh-oh. Why will there be a delay? W-Br: Well, some of the components we received to build the prototype are failing initial tests, so we won’t be able to make the delivery deadline. Janet, could you let the client know? W-Am: Yes, I’ll contact them right away. M-Cn: And l’d like the development team to start giving me daily briefings about progress on this issue.

SCRIPT W-Br: Good evening. Legend Hotel. How may I help you? M-Au: Hello. I'm at the local airport. Does the hotel run shuttle buses to here? SCRIPT W-Br: Looking for an interesting activity to celebrate the coming of spring? Winford Gardens offers an escape filled with calm, peace, and quiet just a few miles from the downtown area. Winford Gardens has acres of outdoor gardens filled with plants you won't typically find anywhere near here. This weekend we will have an exhibition of Mexican blue palms. If you have never seen these striking and unique plants, now is your chance! Winford's cafe is a converted building that used to be a greenhouse. The surrounding tropical plants and flowers help make dining there a pleasure.

SCRIPT M-Au: Good afternoon. Welcome to this week's managers' meeting here at South Truck Deliveries. Beginning this year, we will use a software application called Personnel Profile to enter performance appraisals. Let me introduce Ms. Hwa Young Lee, the head of our IT department. She will walk you through how to enroll in a training course on using Personnel Profile, and you will complete your enrollment by the end of this meeting.

SCRIPT W-Br: Hi. This is Ms. Mitra. You're scheduled to move my furniture to my new apartment tomorrow morning at eight. I will check first thing tomorrow morning to see what the situation is. But please give me a call as soon as you can. l have an overseas trip coming up next week, so this work will have to happen soon.

SCRIPT M-Cn: Good evening, everyone! Welcome to a new season of City Opera. I bring some bad news, I'm afraid. Soprano Lisa Gornicka informed me earlier today that she will not be able to perform tonight. I know how disappointing this is. But I also have good news! Soprano Rita Marks is in town and has agreed to step in for Ms. Gornicka. Not only is Ms. Marks familiar with the role of Laura, but she also knows the choreography, since she worked with our director when this production premiered in Toronto. Wondering what her voice is like? Well, judge for yourself, but I saw the reviews from Toronto. l can guarantee that we are in for a treat!

SCRIPT W-Am: Thank you for inviting me and other members of the marketing department to this meeting of the research and development team. We always welcome the opportunity to share customer information about our toys with you. I'd like to start off with some information about the remote-control car that we launched in department stores and toy stores one month ago. It's been a mixed bag. Customers love the smooth action of the car and the high speed it can achieve. However, they are somewhat disappointed with the rechargeable battery the car comes with. I encourage your team to find ways to make the battery charge faster and last longer.

SCRIPT W-Br: Attention, Shopsmart shoppers! ln case you didn't pick up our flyer, we are kicking off a Shopsmart giveaway event. For every two cans of Shopsmart soup or vegetables that you buy, you will be entered in a drawing to win a gift certificate that can be used at any Shopsmart location. Gift certificates worth $100 each will be awarded to three lucky shoppers on May first. This offer is good only for Shopsmart-brand canned goods. Act now! Stock up and join the giveaway! The more you buy, the more chances you have to win!

SCRIPT M-Au: Hi, Mr. Collins. I'm calling from Silva's Flooring. I was about to place your order for the maple floors that you wanted me to put in, but I decided to call you first. I just found out that the hardwood distributor has lowered the price of the oak flooring. I think you originally preferred oak but decided it was too expensive. The reduction looks to be about fifteen percent. Please call me back and let me know if I should still order the maple for you or if you would prefer that I order the oak.

SCRIPT W-Am: Welcome to the Central Valley Environmental Center. We're so grateful to all of you, our volunteers, for coming out today to help with this project to install bluebird nest boxes. The Eastern bluebird is a native species that plays an important role in our environment, but it's threatened by habitat loss and predation. We have numerous donated nest boxes here that will help protect our local bluebird population. Remember that bluebirds prefer open woodlands and grasslands with scattered trees. Some suitable locations are already identified on the maps you've received.

SCRIPT W-Br: Hi, everyone! l want to update you on sales of our lines of dishware after the introduction of our holiday-themed patterns. Our everyday dishware continues to perform as expected. Also, I am pleased to report that our New Year plates are a resounding success: total wholesale orders have outpaced those of our popular Dawn series of fine china. We spent a lot on the design for New Year, so our CEO will be happy to learn that the investment has paid off. Looks like we will need to rethink the Harvest Festival brand, though. Unless total sales reach those of our Cafe series by next year, we may even discontinue it.

SCRIPT M-Au: I'd like to welcome all of you to your first day of work at the Wildcats customer service office. Baseball season starts in exactly one month. We expect ticket sales to be very good because the Wildcats had such a great season last year. As you can see on the chart, we have four packages. Make sure you let our customers know about the new Sunday package. It includes tickets for every Sunday home game throughout the season. Our Friday night package, holiday package, and discount package were available last year and should remain popular.

History

Welcome to the historic H. G. Walsh Building and North Riverview Restaurant!

 

Constructed by H. G. Walsh in 1897, the building served as Astoria's post office until 1942. It has subsequently been a general store, a boutique, and a family-run restaurant serving up fresh seafood. Over the past century, the building's second floor has been used for private parties, such as birthdays and weddings.

 

Facing a potential demolition in the late 1970s, the building was purchased by its current owners, Henry and Juana Thomason, in 1981. Subsequent investment and extensive renovation helped save the H. G. Walsh Building, and in 1996 it gained status on the National Register of Historic Places. With its stunning views of the Columbia River and an extensive seasonal menu, the H. G. Walsh Building has become a prime destination for visitors to Oregon's Pacific coast.

Headquarters Teams Help Out in Stores

Hannen has operated one of the largest chains of department stores in the Southwest since 1962. The In-Store Project, launched on February 7, is a new initiative from the Hannen Department Store corporate operations team. Following recommendations from employees at various levels, the initiative was developed to allow company headquarters to better understand the day-to-day operations at the individual store level.

KARLINGA BEACH

(December 4)—More resources need to be allocated to promote cultural tourism to the region, officials from the Karlinga Beach Tourism Department (KBTD) concluded at a planning meeting held yesterday. The department also drafted a new marketing campaign, titled “Connect with Karlinga Beach,” that will highlight the region’s rich history and culture. “Everyone agreed that, moving forward, we should focus less on advertising traditional beach activities and more on new eco-friendly tourist activities,” said Tourism Director Arnold Bhatt.

 

During the meeting, Mr. Bhatt gave a presentation in which he analyzed the results from an online questionnaire designed by students from the region’s university. Respondents included both local residents and tourists. In one key result, more than 80 percent of all respondents agreed that there should be more emphasis on promoting eco-friendly tourism. In another finding, more than 75 percent of surveyed tourists indicated they would like to see a wider selection of locally sourced, organic food options. “For me, the tourists’ response was unexpected,” said Mr. Bhatt. “But, looking at the full picture, it makes sense, as there are many family farms on the land near the beach.”

 

The insights from the survey are welcome news for Kathy Li, who operates the KLP Organic Farm. Its grocery store, located on the farm property, is stocked year- round with fresh, seasonal, organically grown produce. In the future, if tourist visits increase, Ms. Li plans to offer prepared foods and beverages.

New Addition to Shadeside Plaza

BIRCH CITY (November 12)—Design Glory, a jewelry business operated by lifelong Birch City resident Tamara Banda, has set up a brick and- mortar store in the city’s Shadeside Plaza shopping area. — [1] —. Ms. Banda said the shop, which opened on November 9, features her entire line of handmade jewelry along with a selection of beautiful natural crystals that can become the centerpiece of any room.

 

Ms. Banda emphasizes that she sets her jewelry brand apart from others by offering handmade designs at price points that won’t break a budget. To keep her overhead costs in check, she says she sources materials creatively from a variety of local metal suppliers. — [2] —. Although managing the store, which is open Tuesday through Saturday from 11:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M., will occupy much of her time, Ms. Banda said she still intends to operate booths at regional arts festivals. — [3] —. She will also continue to serve on the planning committee for the annual art show at Central Arts University, where she learned her jewelry-making techniques.

 

The idea of opening a physical store came to Ms. Banda when a friend, Brad Machado, told her of his positive experience in operating his retail bookshop on the opposite side of Shadeside Plaza from where Design Glory is now. — [4] —. The shopping area, he said, benefits from the heavy foot traffic nearby.

MEMO

To: Kildare Recreation Centre Staff

From: Madeline Byrne

Date: 11 April

Subject: Daily Passes

 

As discussed in April’s staff meeting, we are considering raising the cost of daily passes from €5 to €9. The exact increase will be decided in our May meeting. This change is expected to bring in an extra €5,000 over the next year, which we will use toward the cost of replacing our outdoor running track. With the increased revenue from the fee change, we will be close to the €7,000 needed for the improvement.

 

I realize that the outdoor running season is short, and I know that in our meeting, some staff members wanted to consider other uses for the money. The possibilities of using the funds for a remodeled reception area, a new floor for the dance studio, or more flat-screen televisions throughout the centre were raised. However, the board of directors thought it would be wiser to focus on the improvement most frequently requested by our members. The upgrades suggested by the staff fall into the €1,000–€2,000 range, and we hope to be able to consider them in the coming years.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

NOTICE

Kildare Recreation Centre Visitors

 

Effective 1 June, the cost of a daily pass for nonmembers will be €8. This modest increase will allow us to provide visitors with a much better outdoor running track. The cost of monthly and annual memberships has not changed. Please visit the registration office during regular business hours to discuss membership-related issues.

questions.explanation: "Before" là liên từ/giới từ phù hợp về nghĩa và ngữ pháp (đi với V-ing) để chỉ trình tự thời gian: khảo sát xong rồi mới quyết định thay đổi nhà cung cấp.

questions.stem: Although Mr. Cho was ------- about transferring to the Houston office, he is now working there confidently and productively.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ tobe "was", ta cần một tính từ để miêu tả trạng thái của chủ ngữ Mr. Cho. "Hesitant" (do dự) phản ánh đúng ý nghĩa tương phản với trạng thái "tự tin" ở vế sau.

questions.stem: The personnel office should be contacted about unpaid leave ------- supervisors cannot approve it.
questions.explanation: Liên từ "as" ở đây mang nghĩa là "bởi vì" (because), dùng để giải thích lý do tại sao cần liên hệ với văn phòng nhân sự (vì quản lý trực tiếp không có quyền phê duyệt).

questions.stem: Yesterday the board voted to ------- with discussions about acquiring Atlasburg Financial.
questions.explanation: Sau cấu trúc "voted to" (bỏ phiếu để làm gì), ta cần một động từ nguyên mẫu (V-bare). "Proceed with" là cụm từ cố định mang nghĩa "tiếp tục thực hiện".

questions.stem: Robles Corporation encourages employees to work toward a ------- goal, rather than pursuing individual interests.
questions.explanation: Tính từ "common" (chung) tạo thành cụm "common goal" (mục tiêu chung), tạo sự tương phản rõ rệt với "individual interests" (lợi ích cá nhân) ở vế sau.

questions.stem: The ------- in the brochure are an accurate representation of what guests staying at the resort can expect to find.
questions.explanation: Sau mạo từ "The" và đứng trước cụm giới từ, ta cần một danh từ. Vì động từ tobe là "are", danh từ phải ở dạng số nhiều "images".

questions.stem: Current employees interested in the new managerial position should ------- about the internal hiring process.
questions.explanation: Động từ "inquire" thường đi với giới từ "about" mang nghĩa là "hỏi/tìm hiểu thông tin". Đây là hành động phù hợp cho nhân viên khi muốn biết về quy trình tuyển dụng.

questions.stem: Colleagues in the accounting department consider the matter closed and ------- cannot provide more input.
questions.explanation: "Consequently" (Do đó) là trạng từ liên kết chỉ kết quả, phù hợp để nối hai vế: vì vấn đề đã đóng nên kết quả là họ không thể đóng góp thêm ý kiến.

questions.stem: The CEO hopes that the consultant’s advice will ultimately ------- higher profits for the company.
questions.explanation: Động từ "yield" trong ngữ cảnh kinh doanh mang nghĩa là "mang lại/sản sinh ra" (lợi nhuận). Đây là kết quả mà CEO mong đợi từ lời khuyên của tư vấn viên.

questions.stem: A team of experts is reviewing the contract from a' financial ------- so please do not share it with the client yet.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ "from a financial perspective" là một cách diễn đạt cố định mang nghĩa là "dưới góc độ tài chính" hoặc "từ khía cạnh tài chính".

questions.stem: To prevent noise that is distracting to performers, the lobby gift shop is ------- open during performances.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào ngữ cảnh "tránh tiếng ồn gây xao nhãng cho người biểu diễn", cửa hàng quà tặng "không bao giờ" (never) mở cửa trong lúc đang có biểu diễn là hợp lý nhất.

questions.stem: Zuper Brite lightbulbs ------- reduce energy consumption when compared with standard incandescent lightbulbs.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng trước động từ "reduce" nên ta cần một trạng từ để bổ nghĩa. "Greatly reduce" (giảm đáng kể).

questions.stem: The airport’s proposed ------- project will include two remodeled terminals and an updated transportation system.
questions.explanation: Đứng sau tính từ "proposed" (được đề xuất) cần một danh từ. Dựa vào việc có "nhà ga được cải tạo" và "hệ thống giao thông cập nhật", "modernization" (hiện đại hóa) là từ phù hợp nhất.

questions.stem: Market Research is the ------- of the company concerned with better understanding our clients’ needs.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đóng vai trò là danh từ chính của cụm "the ------- of the company". "Division" (bộ phận/phòng ban) phù hợp để chỉ một phần trong cơ cấu công ty.

questions.stem: Mr. Tanaka was so pleased by the quarterly performance report ------- he canceled the weekly updates.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc "so + adj + that + clause" dùng để chỉ kết quả: "quá... đến nỗi mà". Ông Tanaka hài lòng đến mức ông ấy đã hủy các cập nhật hàng tuần.

questions.stem: Quincycom’s price increase is justifiable ------- there is an improvement in the quality of the Internet service we receive.
questions.explanation: Liên từ "only if" (chỉ khi) diễn đạt một điều kiện bắt buộc: việc tăng giá chỉ hợp lý nếu chất lượng dịch vụ được cải thiện.

questions.stem: The chart attached to this e-mail presents a ------- of Vivasyco’s latest smartphone with a model from Eustace Tech.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào ngữ cảnh so sánh smartphone của hai hãng khác nhau, danh từ "comparison" (sự so sánh) là lựa chọn chính xác nhất.

questions.stem: It is the catering director's ------- to inform the chef of the intended menu well in advance of the event.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng sau sở hữu cách "director's" nên cần một danh từ. Cụm "It is someone's obligation to do something" nghĩa là "nghĩa vụ của ai đó là làm việc gì".

questions.stem: Given her experience in health care, Ms. Chung is ------- well suited to manage the company’s wellness program.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "particularly" (đặc biệt) được dùng để nhấn mạnh mức độ phù hợp của Ms. Chung đối với vị trí công việc dựa trên kinh nghiệm của cô ấy.

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following product description.
questions.explanation: Từ "thereby" được dùng như một trạng từ liên kết để chỉ kết quả của hành động trước đó (việc gắn giá treo lên tường). Theo sau nó thường là một cấu trúc V-ing để chỉ hệ quả trực tiếp.

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following product description.
questions.explanation: Ngữ cảnh mô tả cánh tay của giá treo có thể "uốn cong theo nhiều hướng" (bends in multiple directions). Do đó, tính từ "flexible" (linh hoạt) là lựa chọn phù hợp nhất để miêu tả tính chất của sản phẩm này.

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following product description.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng sau động từ "placed" (được đặt) để bổ nghĩa cho cách thức đặt tivi. Trạng từ "exactly" (một cách chính xác) thường đi kèm với các cụm từ chỉ vị trí để nhấn mạnh sự chuẩn xác.

questions.stem: Questions 131-134 refer to the following product description.

options.text: Like all products by Sanberg Industries, it also comes with a five-year guarantee.
Your inquiry about your Sanberg product will be addressed within two business days.
We are grateful that you have worked for Sanberg Industries for so many years.
High-definition televisions offer an improved viewing experience.

questions.explanation: Bài viết đang giới thiệu các ưu điểm của sản phẩm giá treo TV. Câu (A) cung cấp thêm thông tin về chế độ hậu mãi (bảo hành 5 năm), là một cách kết thúc bài giới thiệu sản phẩm rất phổ biến và hợp lý.

questions.stem: Questions 135-138 refer to the following e-mail.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào câu tiếp theo "Your participation in our... contest", ta biết người này đã gửi ảnh tham gia cuộc thi. "Submission" (bản bài nộp/sự nộp bài) là danh từ chính xác để chỉ tác phẩm được gửi đi dự thi.

questions.stem: Questions 135-138 refer to the following e-mail.

options.text: Photographing nature is a difficult skill to learn.
Every reader of our magazine knows that wildlife is precious.
Asia Nature magazine has been published for fourteen years.
These professionals are among the best in their field.

questions.explanation: Câu trước nhắc tới "panel of experts" (ban giám khảo chuyên gia). Câu (D) tiếp nối bằng cách khẳng định trình độ của họ ("These professionals"), và câu sau đó kể về thành tựu của họ để minh chứng.

questions.stem: Questions 135-138 refer to the following e-mail.
questions.explanation: Động từ "value" ở đây mang nghĩa là trân trọng hoặc đánh giá cao. Trong cấu trúc "...who care about the environment and [verb] nature's beauty", ta cần một động từ nguyên mẫu song song với "care".

questions.stem: Questions 135-138 refer to the following e-mail.
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn đang kêu gọi sự đóng góp (contribution). Do đó, "generous readers" (những độc giả hào phóng) là cụm từ phù hợp nhất để chỉ những người sẵn sàng ủng hộ tài chính cho tạp chí.

questions.stem: Questions 139-142 refer to the following article.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ "as well as" (cũng như là) được dùng để liệt kê thêm các mặt hàng mà cửa hàng bán: bên cạnh pasta và nước sốt tự làm thì còn có hàng nhập khẩu (imported goods).

questions.stem: Questions 139-142 refer to the following article.

options.text: The weather on Saturday is expected to be beautiful.
This area is already home to several bakeries, bistros, and coffee shops.
Fresh pastas and sauces are superior to mass-produced ones.
We will soon learn what consumers think of the products that Salerno’s offers.

questions.explanation: Câu sau nói về việc khu vực này "đang trở thành nơi phổ biến cho thực phẩm cao cấp". Câu (B) cung cấp bằng chứng cho điều đó bằng cách liệt kê các loại hình dịch vụ ăn uống đã có sẵn tại đây.

questions.stem: Questions 139-142 refer to the following article.
questions.explanation: Câu này giới thiệu về lý lịch của chủ cửa hàng. "Previously" (trước đây) là trạng từ phù hợp nhất để chỉ công việc cũ của ông ấy là đầu bếp tại Milano's trước khi tự mở cửa hàng.

questions.stem: Questions 139-142 refer to the following article.
questions.explanation: Leo Sarri mở cửa hàng thực phẩm (food shop), vì vậy ông ấy đang gia nhập thế giới "retail" (bán lẻ). Đây là từ chính xác nhất để mô tả hoạt động kinh doanh trực tiếp tới người tiêu dùng.

questions.stem: Questions 143-146 refer to the following advertisement.
questions.explanation: Sau danh từ "machinists" là một loạt các động từ liệt kê nhiệm vụ. Theo cấu trúc "seek someone TO DO something", ta cần dạng "to-infinitive" để chỉ mục đích hoặc nhiệm vụ của người được tuyển.

questions.stem: Questions 143-146 refer to the following advertisement.

options.text: Send specifications for your project to our production director.
Our factory manufactures components used in industrial equipment.
We hope you enjoy the tour of our innovative manufacturing plant.
Congratulations on being hired by Caliphar Tech Industries.

questions.explanation: Câu tiếp theo nêu ví dụ về các thiết bị mà công ty sản xuất (máy bơm, quạt). Do đó, câu (B) là câu dẫn nhập phù hợp nhất khi giới thiệu chung về hoạt động sản xuất của nhà máy.

questions.stem: Questions 143-146 refer to the following advertisement.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ cố định "under pressure" có nghĩa là "chịu áp lực". Trong ngữ cảnh môi trường làm việc nhanh và thời hạn chặt chẽ, nhân viên cần làm việc tốt khi bị áp lực.

questions.stem: Questions 143-146 refer to the following advertisement.
questions.explanation: Trong các thông báo tuyển dụng, cụm từ "competitive salaries" (mức lương cạnh tranh) là một thuật ngữ cực kỳ phổ biến để thu hút ứng viên bằng cách ám chỉ mức lương tốt so với thị trường.

questions.stem: What is being advertised?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Cụm từ "marionettes" (con rối điều khiển bằng dây) tương đương với cụm từ "puppet show" (buổi biểu diễn múa rối). Logic: Nhà hát múa rối sử dụng các con rối để biểu diễn một câu chuyện kịch tính.

questions.stem: What is Uncle Pete's version of Moose Lake based on?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Danh từ "ballet" (vở kịch múa) tương đương với cụm từ "dance performance" (buổi biểu diễn nhảy múa).

questions.stem: What is indicated about Clean House Janitorial Services?

options.text: It offers a discount on carpet cleaning.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Cụm trạng từ "since 1972" (kể từ năm 1972) tương đương với cụm "founded in 1972" (được thành lập vào năm 1972).

questions.stem: Who in Copper County may use the coupon?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Cụm từ "New customer promotion" (khuyến mãi dành cho khách hàng mới) xác định đối tượng sử dụng được là "New customers" (những khách hàng mới).

questions.stem: Why did Mr. Gitane receive the letter?

options.text: He just got a new dentist.
It is time for a routine checkup.
Red Street Dental Care is requesting his feedback.
He was dissatisfied with his last visit.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Cụm từ "due for your semiannual dental care visit" (đến hạn cho chuyến thăm khám nha khoa 6 tháng một lần) tương đương với cụm "time for a routine checkup" (đã đến lúc kiểm tra định kỳ).

questions.stem: What does the letter state about the teeth- whitening service?

options.text: It costs about the same as invisible braces.
It was not available at Red Street Dental Care until recently.
It takes up to six months to obtain the desired results.
It is not covered by dental insurance plans.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Cụm từ "now offer" (hiện nay cung cấp) ngụ ý đây là dịch vụ mới, tương đương với ý "not available... until recently" (không có sẵn cho đến tận gần đây).

questions.stem: At 8:14 A.M., what does Ms. Penn most likely mean when she writes, “I'm here”?

options.text: She is in the same room as Ms. Thomas.
She is waiting for Ms. Thomas to arrive.
She is already at the office.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Trong ngữ cảnh được hỏi về việc đã có mặt tại văn phòng chưa, "I'm here" (Tôi có mặt tại đây) tương đương với trạng thái "already at the office" (đã có mặt ở văn phòng).

questions.stem: What will Ms, Penn most likely do next?

options.text: Arrange seats in a staff room

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Hành động "arrange them on the round table" (sắp xếp chúng lên bàn tròn) tương đương với cụm "Put cards on a table" (đặt các tấm thiệp lên một chiếc bàn).

questions.stem: The word “served” in paragraph 1, line 2, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Cụm động từ "served as" (đóng vai trò là/phục vụ với chức năng là) tương đương với động từ "functioned" (hoạt động/vận hành).

questions.stem: What is suggested about the H. G. Walsh Building?

options.text: It is located on the waterfront.
It is located next to a post office.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Đặc điểm "views of the Columbia River" (nhìn ra sông) tương đương với trạng thái "located on the waterfront" (nằm sát mặt nước/ven sông).

questions.stem: What can be purchased for less than $10?
questions.explanation:
157. Cái gì có thể mua với giá dưới $10?
A. Súp hải sản (Seafood chowder)
B. Cá và khoai tây chiên (Fish and chips)
C. Cải thìa (Bok choy)
D. Salad của bếp trưởng (Chef's salad)

questions.stem: Why did the company start the project?

options.text: It is a current trend among large companies.
It was suggested by some employees.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Cụm "Following recommendations from employees" (theo lời khuyên/đề xuất của nhân viên) tương đương với cụm "suggested by some employees" (được gợi ý bởi một số nhân viên).

questions.stem: What does the project involve?

options.text: Store employees visiting other department store chains
Interns being hired to receive on-the-job training
Corporate employees temporarily working in stores
Teams of employees working to redesign stores

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Ý "places employees from the corporate headquarters in stores" (đưa nhân viên từ trụ sở vào cửa hàng) tương đương với việc "Corporate employees temporarily working in stores" (nhân viên văn phòng tạm thời làm việc tại cửa hàng).

questions.stem: What does the article indicate about the future of the project?

options.text: The company plans to do it again each year.
The company plans to expand it to other stores it owns.
It is being discontinued because it has been unsuccessful.
It will not be completed because it is too expensive.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Trạng từ "annually" (hàng năm) tương đương với cụm "do it again each year" (thực hiện lại mỗi năm).

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the article?

options.text: To explain a decrease in local tourism
To encourage participation in a survey

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Hành động "drafted a new marketing campaign" (phác thảo chiến dịch tiếp thị mới) tương đương với ý "outline proposed marketing plans" (phác thảo các kế hoạch tiếp thị được đề xuất).

questions.stem: What is indicated about Karlinga Beach?

options.text: It has a short tourism season.
It is accessed mostly by ferry.
It is close to a university.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Dẫn chứng "students from the region’s university" (sinh viên từ trường đại học của vùng) chứng minh địa điểm bãi biển này "close to a university" (gần một trường đại học).

questions.stem: According to the article, what is true about Mr. Bhatt?

options.text: He was surprised by a survey result.
He changed the design of a questionnaire.
He is concerned about a region losing farmland.
He wants to increase attendance at public meetings.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Tính từ "unexpected" (không ngờ tới/bất ngờ) tương đương với tính từ "surprised" (ngạc nhiên).

questions.stem: What is mentioned about KLP Organic Farm?

options.text: It offers free tours to hotel guests.
It sells fruits and vegetables on-site.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Cụm "grocery store, located on the farm property" (cửa hàng nằm ngay tại trang trại) và danh từ "produce" (nông sản/rau quả) tương đương với cụm "sells fruits and vegetables on-site" (bán trái cây và rau quả tại chỗ).

questions.stem: What is indicated about Treks Auto?

options.text: It is focused on great customer service.
It has been a family-run business for five generations.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "commitment to honest service" (cam kết dịch vụ trung thực) ≈ "focused on great customer service" (tập trung vào dịch vụ khách hàng tốt). Đáp án c.

questions.stem: What is indicated about the oil-change packages?

options.text: They each include free brake-pad replacement.
Only one of the packages offers a fluid fill-up.
They are based on the number of miles a vehicle has been driven.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "Recommended for vehicles with... miles" (được khuyên dùng cho xe có số dặm...) ≈ "based on the number of miles a vehicle has been driven" (dựa trên số dặm xe đã chạy). Đáp án d.

questions.stem: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3] and [4] does the following sentence best belong? “Ask any of our service technicians if you are unsure of the best one for your car.”
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Câu cần điền (Hỏi kỹ thuật viên nếu không chắc nên chọn loại nào tốt nhất) là lời khuyên bổ trợ sau khi khách hàng vừa đọc xong các lựa chọn. Vị trí [4] nằm sau danh sách lựa chọn là hợp lý nhất về logic tư vấn. Đáp án d.

questions.stem: What is indicated about Design Glory?

options.text: It had a delayed opening date.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "natural crystals" (tinh thể tự nhiên) ≈ "decorative stones" (đá trang trí). Đáp án b.

questions.stem: What does Ms. Banda say is special about her jewelry?

options.text: It is designed by local students.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "price points that won’t break a budget" (mức giá không làm thâm hụt ngân sách) ≈ "affordable" (giá cả phải chăng). Đáp án c.

questions.stem: Who is Mr. Machado?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "operating his retail bookshop" (điều hành hiệu sách bán lẻ) ≈ "bookseller" (người bán sách). Đáp án d.

questions.stem: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3] and [4] does the following sentence best belong? ''She noted as well that she will be participating in the City Art Museum’s craft fair next month.”
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Câu cần điền (tham gia hội chợ thủ công tháng tới) bổ sung chi tiết cho ý định "tham gia các lễ hội" đã nêu trước đó. Vị trí [3] giúp kết nối các hoạt động sự kiện của bà Banda. Đáp án c.

questions.stem: Why does Ms. Kyle expect to be late for work?

options.text: The bus is slow because of poor weather.
The bus is stuck in traffic.
The bus arrived late at her stop.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "It’s all backed up" / "barely moving" (tắc nghẽn/hầu như không nhúc nhích) ≈ "stuck in traffic" (kẹt xe). Đáp án b.

questions.stem: Why was the meeting postponed?

options.text: A colleague is out of the office.
The client needs more time to prepare.
Mr. Bodin has a scheduling conflict.
Ms. Mata needs to prepare an update.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "Mr. Chang is in Portsville" (Ông Chang đang ở nơi khác) ≈ "A colleague is out of the office" (Một đồng nghiệp đang không có mặt tại văn phòng). Đáp án a.

questions.stem: At 8:24 A.M., what does Ms. Kyle most likely mean when she writes, “Really”?

options.text: She is disappointed by certain designs.
She is surprised by Ms. Mata's comment.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "Really?" (Thật sao?) thể hiện sự ngạc nhiên (surprised) khi nhận được thông tin mà mình chưa biết từ đồng nghiệp. Đáp án c.

questions.stem: What is indicated about the project?

options.text: It is more expensive than planned
It cannot be completed on time.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "over the allocated budget" (vượt ngân sách) ≈ "more expensive than planned" (đắt đỏ/tốn kém hơn so với kế hoạch). Đáp án a.

questions.stem: What is included in the job advertisement?

options.text: A brief history of the Thompson and Groves law firm
B. Directions to a company’s office
A description of the job’s pay and benefits
A description of the ideal applicant

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "The best candidate" (Ứng viên tốt nhất) ≈ "description of the ideal applicant" (mô tả về ứng viên lý tưởng). Đáp án d.

questions.stem: What most likely is one of Ms. Powell’s job responsibilities?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Làm việc tại bộ phận "human resources" (nhân sự) thường gắn liền với trách nhiệm "Hiring new employees" (tuyển dụng nhân viên mới). Đáp án c.

questions.stem: What does Mr. Ivanov indicate in his e-mail?

options.text: He has changed his career goals.
He has decided to stay at his present job.
He will apply for a different job.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "not... leave Wilson Law" (không rời bỏ công ty Wilson) ≈ "stay at his present job" (ở lại công việc hiện tại). Đáp án b.

questions.stem: What does the e-mail mention about the Thompson and Groves law firm?

options.text: It is well-known for its successes.
It will be moving to a larger space.
It no longer specializes in environmental issues.
It will be hosting an international conference.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "illustrious" / "won so many high-profile... cases" (lừng lẫy/thắng nhiều vụ kiện lớn) ≈ "well-known for its successes" (nổi tiếng vì những thành công). Đáp án a.

questions.stem: What is suggested about Mr. Ivanov?

options.text: He received a promotion in May.
He met with Ms. Powell in June.
He and Ms. Powell have a mutual friend.
He has just completed a certification program.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Vì ông Ivanov đã được mời làm việc (offering me the position), ông ấy chắc chắn đã trải qua vòng phỏng vấn diễn ra vào tháng 6. Đáp án b.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the memo?

options.text: To announce an increase in membership numbers
To explain how certain funds will be used
To describe tasks to be done for an event
To solicit donations for a project

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Toàn bộ bản ghi nhớ tập trung vào việc giải thích cách sử dụng (how... will be used) khoản tiền thu thêm từ việc tăng phí. Đáp án b.

questions.stem: What did the staff do at the April meeting?

options.text: They designed a survey for recreation center members.
They proposed upgrades to a recreation center.
They considered moving a reception area.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: "were raised" (đã được đưa ra/nêu ra bởi nhân viên) ≈ "proposed upgrades" (đề xuất các nâng cấp). Đáp án c.

questions.stem: According to the memo, what do the recreation center members most frequently ask for?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Sự cải thiện này chính là "replacing our outdoor running track" đã đề cập ở đoạn trên. Đáp án d.

questions.stem: In the notice, the word ''modest” in paragraph 1, line 2, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Trong bối cảnh nói về mức tăng giá (từ 5 lên 8 Euro), "modest" (khiêm tốn) có nghĩa là mức tăng này nhỏ (small), không đáng kể. Đáp án d.

questions.stem: What is true about the new fee for daily passes for nonmembers?

options.text: It is less than what was originally considered.
It will be effective starting May 1.
It was approved at a June meeting.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Mức phí thực tế (8 Euro) thấp hơn (less than) so với mức dự kiến ban đầu được thảo luận trong bản ghi nhớ (9 Euro). Đáp án a.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the first e-mail?

options.text: To share information about a new job opening
To ask whether a company is hiring new staff
To learn whether a colleague will attend an upcoming conference
To congratulate someone for getting a new job

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Cụm từ "post a job" (đăng tuyển một công việc) tương đương với cụm "share information about a new job opening" (chia sẻ thông tin về một vị trí công việc mới đang mở).

questions.stem: What does the company that Ms. Markas works for produce?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Các danh từ cụ thể "copiers, and printers" (máy photocopy và máy in) được nhóm chung vào cụm danh từ "Office equipment" (thiết bị văn phòng).

questions.stem: What is explained in the second e-mail?

options.text: The procedure for submitting an application
What applicants can expect during an interview
The next steps of the hiring process

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Các hành động "contact... to schedule" (liên hệ để đặt lịch) và "receive a request" (nhận yêu cầu) mô tả cụ thể cho cụm "next steps of the hiring process" (các bước tiếp theo của quy trình tuyển dụng).

questions.stem: What will AMTR Corporation do during the first two weeks of December?

options.text: Perform the first round of interviews

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Cụm "Interviews will be held" (các cuộc phỏng vấn sẽ được tổ chức) tương đương với cụm "Perform the first round of interviews" (thực hiện vòng phỏng vấn đầu tiên).

questions.stem: What is most likely true about Mr. Cruz?

options.text: He will begin the job in November.
He has a degree in industrial design.
He recently interviewed for a new job.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Việc "meet the qualifications" (đáp ứng các tiêu chuẩn/trình độ chuyên môn) cho vị trí thiết kế công nghiệp trong ngữ cảnh bài đọc tương đương với việc "has a degree in industrial design" (có bằng cấp về thiết kế công nghiệp).

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the letter?

options.text: To get a cost estimate for a new roof
To request a deposit for a job
To ask a contractor to do a project

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Cụm "confirm our agreement" (xác nhận thỏa thuận của chúng tôi) tương đương với cụm "finalize a business arrangement" (hoàn tất một thỏa thuận kinh doanh).

questions.stem: What does Mr. Sage indicate about the Prime Technology System?

options.text: It requires a separate fee for the ten-year warranty.
It prevents water from leaking into a house.
It is available for only certain types of shingles.
It requires a large crew to install.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Ý "keep your house dry" (giữ cho ngôi nhà của bạn khô ráo) tương đương với cụm "prevents water from leaking into a house" (ngăn nước rò rỉ vào trong nhà).

questions.stem: Where is a shingles installation scheduled to take place on August 3?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Tên địa điểm "Landsford Apartments" trong lịch trình thi công tương ứng với địa danh được nhắc tới trong câu hỏi.

questions.stem: What color shingles will the crew be installing at Kendelwood Motel?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Mã số sản phẩm "#302" tương đương với tên màu sắc "Lawnwood Blue" (Xanh Lawnwood).

questions.stem: When will Shingle Town Roofing do work at 8021 Daffodil Lane?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Thời gian cụ thể "August 4" (Ngày 4 tháng 8) tương đương với thứ trong tuần là "On Wednesday" (Vào thứ Tư).

questions.stem: According to the Web page, what is true about the maker of Carina Solutions software?

options.text: It makes products for the transportation industry.
It makes two versions of its software.
Travelers use its products to find discounted hotel prices.
Its products are not yet available for sale.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Việc nhắc đến "trial version" (phiên bản dùng thử) và "Premier version" (phiên bản cao cấp) tương đương với ý "makes two versions of its software" (tạo ra hai phiên bản phần mềm).

questions.stem: What is implied about Ms. Yan?

options.text: She has been using Carina Solutions for nearly three months.
She was referred to Carina Solutions by another client.
She plans to stay at a hotel during her next trip.
She works for a software company.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Vì bản dùng thử kéo dài 3 tháng (theo trang web), việc nó "expires tomorrow" (hết hạn vào ngày mai) tương đương với việc người dùng đã "using... for nearly three months" (sử dụng được gần ba tháng).

questions.stem: What is Ms. Yan’s concern about hotel guest information?

options.text: The system does not protect it with a secure password.
She cannot enter corrections to misspelled names or addresses.
It must be entered every time a guest makes a reservation.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Hành động "reenter... manually" (nhập lại thủ công/bằng tay) tương đương với ý "must be entered every time a guest makes a reservation" (phải được nhập mỗi lần khách hàng thực hiện đặt phòng).

questions.stem: What does Mr. Feldman indicate about the company’s videos?

options.text: They contain information about interesting places to visit.
They are available for guests to view in their hotel rooms.
They describe many ways that the company’s software can be used.
They were created by the company very recently.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Cụm "instructional videos" (video hướng dẫn) tương đương với cụm "describe many ways that the company’s software can be used" (mô tả nhiều cách mà phần mềm của công ty có thể được sử dụng).

questions.stem: What is suggested about the Premier version of Carina Solutions software?

options.text: It must be updated every three months.
It addresses Ms. Yan’s second concern.
Optional features can be added for a fee.
Ms. Yan may contact Mr. Feldman to receive a discount coupon.

questions.explanation: Paraphrase: Ý "interfaces are the same across all devices" (giao diện giống nhau trên mọi thiết bị) tương đương với việc "addresses Ms. Yan’s second concern" (giải quyết mối bận tâm thứ hai của bà Yan về chức năng trên điện thoại di động).
